records.rationale: Verified in the diff: Admin::EmbeddingController#update only calls render_serialized on @embedding fetched by fetch_embedding (which just reads EmbeddableHost.all) — nothing is persisted. This is a verifiable behavioral regression from the removed setting's guaranteed default category.
